pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Sahara Family Clinic, New Baneshwor: family doctors and a same-day lab
pages.seoDescription: Family doctors, children’s care, women’s health and a same-day lab in New Baneshwor, Kathmandu. Walk in before 11:00 or book a visit. Clear fees.

props.title: A family doctor who knows your name
props.text: General practice, children’s care, women’s health and a same-day lab under one roof in New Baneshwor. Walk in before eleven, or book a time that suits you.

image.alt: The clinic’s bright reception and waiting area

props.eyebrow: Open Sunday to Friday 7:00 to 19:00 · Saturday mornings

props.heading: What people come to us for
props.intro: Most visits start with a twenty-minute consultation. If you need a specialist we do not have, we will say so and refer you.

items.title: Fevers, coughs and stomach trouble
items.text: Seen the same morning, with tests downstairs if you need them.

items.title: Diabetes and blood pressure
items.text: Regular reviews, medicine adjustments and a written plan you can follow at home.

items.title: Children and vaccinations
items.text: Newborn checks, the national schedule plus optional vaccines, growth and school forms.

items.title: Pregnancy and women’s health
items.text: Antenatal care, ultrasound, family planning, smear tests and menopause advice.

items.title: Health checks
items.text: Blood, urine, ECG and a doctor who explains every number to you.

items.title: Physiotherapy
items.text: Back and neck pain, sports injuries and recovery after surgery.

props.heading: Doctors you will see
props.intro: Three doctors here every week, and visiting specialists by appointment.

people.name: Dr. Anjana Shrestha
people.bio: MD General Practice, BPKIHS. Twenty years of family medicine, the last twelve here. Sees adults and children; special interest in diabetes and thyroid care.

people.name: Dr. Prabin Karki
people.bio: MD Paediatrics, IOM Maharajgunj. Newborn checks, vaccinations, growth and development, childhood asthma. Tuesday and Friday afternoons for school forms.

people.name: Dr. Sunita Gurung
people.bio: MS Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Paropakar Maternity Hospital. Antenatal care, ultrasound, family planning and menopause clinics.

items.title: Walk in or book
items.text: Walk in before 11:00, or book online or by phone for a set time.

items.title: Register at the desk
items.text: Bring an ID and any old reports or medicines. It takes five minutes.

items.title: See the doctor
items.text: Twenty minutes for a first visit; ten for a follow-up.

items.title: Tests and medicine
items.text: The lab and pharmacy are on the same floor. No queue across town.

props.heading: A lab downstairs, results the same afternoon
props.intro: No second trip across town. Blood is drawn in the clinic and tested on our own analysers.

image.alt: Blood samples in labelled tubes in the clinic laboratory

items.label: Before 11:00
items.title: Sample taken
items.text: Fasting tests are drawn from 7:00. Bring your previous reports if you have them.

items.label: By 15:00
items.title: Results ready
items.text: Most blood and urine tests are reported the same day, checked by our pathologist.

items.label: Same evening
items.title: Explained by your doctor
items.text: Your doctor reads the results with you, in person or by phone, and writes what changes.

items.label: Always
items.title: Yours to keep
items.text: Reports come as a PDF on Viber or email and on paper, so your next doctor sees them too.

props.heading: Fees, written down
props.intro: What you see here is what you pay. Fees include VAT where it applies.

items.a: Not for general practice before 11:00. Children’s clinic, ultrasound and physiotherapy are by appointment.

items.q: Do you accept insurance or SSF?
items.a: We accept Social Security Fund (SSF) cards and bill most private insurers directly. Bring your card and policy number.
Cash, card, eSewa, Khalti or Fonepay QR.

items.q: Can I get my results on my phone?
items.a: Yes. We send reports as a PDF on Viber or email, and give you the paper copy too.

items.q: What if it is an emergency?
items.a: Go straight to the nearest hospital emergency or call 102 for an ambulance. We are not an emergency department.

props.heading: Find the clinic
props.text: Wheelchair access from the side ramp. Free parking for patients in the basement; the Baneshwor micro stop is a two-minute walk.

pages.title: Services
pages.seoTitle: Services · Sahara Family Clinic, New Baneshwor
pages.seoDescription: Family medicine, children’s clinic, women’s health and pregnancy care, diabetes and blood pressure, physiotherapy and a same-day lab.

props.title: Care for the whole family, in one building
props.text: Six services, one set of records. Your doctor sees your lab results, your physiotherapy notes and your children’s vaccination card in one place.

image.alt: A doctor in conversation with a patient

items.title: Family medicine
items.text: Everyday illness, long-term conditions, travel advice, medical certificates and a second opinion when a hospital plan confuses you. Walk-ins every morning until 11:00.

image.alt: A child being examined by a paediatrician

items.title: Children’s clinic
items.text: Newborn and six-week checks, the full national immunisation schedule, optional vaccines such as typhoid and chickenpox, growth and development, asthma and allergy care.

image.alt: An expectant mother holding her ultrasound print

items.title: Women’s health and pregnancy
items.text: Antenatal care with scans at the right weeks, family planning including implants and IUDs, cervical screening, and menopause clinics every second Wednesday.

image.alt: A nurse measuring a patient’s blood pressure

items.title: Diabetes and blood pressure
items.text: A three-monthly review with HbA1c, kidney tests and a foot and eye check once a year, and a nurse you can message between visits.

image.alt: A physiotherapist working on a patient’s shoulder

items.title: Physiotherapy
items.text: Neck and back pain, frozen shoulder, knee injuries and recovery after surgery. Forty-five-minute sessions and exercises you can do at home.

props.heading: Lab tests and when results are ready

props.caption: Consultation room two, cleaned between every patient.

props.title: Not sure which service you need?
props.text: Call the desk. A nurse will tell you who to see and when.
